purpose: Speech to text for QNC as a plug-in program beside the application (user 2026-10-26: the best offline transcription, a block that can be replaced without building QNC). The AI catalog of the host (catalogs/ai/catalog.json) names the program, the model and the backend; nothing falls back to another engine.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time. A job answers its segments in parts (lines with "part") before its answer. A request { "id": 0, "op": "cancel", "body": <id> } stops the running job; a plug-in that does not end it in 2 s is stopped.

transcribe.body: { model, vad_model?, backend: vulkan | cpu, wav, language, threads }
transcribe.part: { start, end, text, words: [{ start, end, text, p }] }: one segment, times in seconds from the start of wav
transcribe.ok: { language }: the language the text is in

rules: wav is a 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV file in an empty temporary folder of the application (the only file the plug-in reads besides the models); the plug-in writes nothing. language is a code (hr, en...) or auto. backend is the one the catalog chose: a plug-in that cannot run it answers an error, never another backend. Word times are the engine's alignment of each word to the sound. An error is an answer, never a different result.
acceptance: crates/qnc-transcribe-jobs/examples/transcribe_media.rs: a medium that is only read, its sound through the decoder catalog, the time it takes and the words with their times.
